path_decisions.rationale: Hardcoded signal strengths (0.5-0.8) never reach consolidate_signals() which needs strategy_hit_rates; must fix wiring before calibration matters
Regime detection is highest-impact missing feature (ANT-2-1 priority); ADX already computed in indicators/trend.py:100 but never consumed by any strategy
Min_conditions thresholds have severe calibration bugs: mean_reversion vol_ok trivially true (default 0.8), volatility_breakout min=5 nearly impossible (ALL 5 conditions required)
YAML stop_loss_pct never wired into generate_signals; trend_following trailing_stop_atr_mult=3.0 vs YAML 1.5; trailing stop tracks highest CLOSE not HIGH causing premature exits

candidate_solution.summary: Complete signal pipeline wiring map with 7 critical gaps and precise fix locations for each

content.pipeline_trace: strategy.on_bar() -> ctx.emit_signal(strength=HARDCODED) -> ctx.flush_signals() -> _process_signal(signal) -> RiskEngine.check(signal, portfolio) -> PositionSizer.size(signal, portfolio) -> ExecutionEngine.submit_order(request)

critical_gaps.title: consolidate_signals() never called — self-hedging
critical_gaps.current: for strategy in self._strategies: ctx.flush_signals(); for signal in signals: await self._process_signal(signal)
critical_gaps.fix: Group signals by symbol across all strategies, then call SignalGenerator.consolidate_signals() before _process_signal(). Insert after line 152, before line 154.
critical_gaps.fix_sketch: all_signals = []; for strategy in self._strategies: signals = ctx.flush_signals(); all_signals.extend(signals); grouped = group_by_symbol(all_signals); for symbol, sigs in grouped.items(): consolidated = self._signal_generator.consolidate_signals(sigs, self._strategy_hit_rates); if consolidated: await self._process_signal(consolidated)
critical_gaps.win_rate_impact: +5-10% by preventing opposing positions from same symbol

critical_gaps.title: Signal strength hardcoded — condition count not reflected
critical_gaps.current: strength=0.8 (trend_following:108, volatility_breakout:115, ml_ensemble:126); strength=0.7 (mean_reversion:66, funding_rate:81, momentum_rotation:75)
critical_gaps.fix: Map condition_count / total_conditions to strength. E.g. in trend_following: actual_count = long_count value (already computed at line 165); strength = actual_count / 4.0 (4 total conditions). For mean_reversion: strength = long_count / 3.0. For volatility_breakout: strength = long_count / 5.0.
critical_gaps.win_rate_impact: +3-5% by scaling position size to actual signal quality

critical_gaps.title: No regime detection — all strategies fire blindly
critical_gaps.location: No strategy imports or uses adx() from quantflow/indicators/trend.py:100
critical_gaps.current: Strategies have no concept of market regime (trending vs ranging). Mean reversion fires in trends, trend following fires in ranges.
critical_gaps.fix: Add regime filter to engine.py on_bar(). Compute ADX from bar data. Pass regime (trending/ranging/neutral) to each strategy's on_bar(). Strategies gate entry on regime match: trend_following requires ADX > 25, mean_reversion requires ADX < 25, volatility_breakout requires ADX transition.
critical_gaps.win_rate_impact: +8-15% by filtering strategies to their profitable regimes

critical_gaps.title: strategy_win_rates and strategy_hit_rates never populated
critical_gaps.location: quantflow/strategy/engine.py:54 (RiskEngine without strategy_risk_budgets), engine.py:57 (PositionSizer without strategy_win_rates), engine.py:91 (equal 1/N allocation)
critical_gaps.current: RiskEngine._strategy_risk_budgets = {} (empty dict at risk_engine.py:27), PositionSizer.size() called with default win_rate=0.5 (position_sizer.py:39), allocation is 1/N (engine.py:91)
critical_gaps.fix: Track per-strategy trade outcomes in TradingSession. After each fill, record which strategy generated it and whether the trade was profitable. Compute rolling win_rate and hit_rate per strategy. Pass strategy_win_rates to PositionSizer.size(), strategy_risk_budgets to RiskEngine, and use performance-weighted allocation instead of 1/N.
critical_gaps.win_rate_impact: +3-5% by allocating more capital to winning strategies

critical_gaps.title: Position model lacks strategy_id — cannot track per-strategy exposure
critical_gaps.current: Position dataclass has: symbol, quantity, entry_price, current_price, unrealized_pnl — no strategy_id field
critical_gaps.fix: Add strategy_id: str = '' field to Position dataclass. Update PortfolioManager.update_position() to accept and store strategy_id. Update RiskEngine._check_strategy_budget() to filter positions by strategy_id instead of summing all positions.
critical_gaps.win_rate_impact: +2-3% by enabling correct per-strategy budget checks

critical_gaps.title: min_conditions calibration bugs
critical_gaps.current: mean_reversion: vol_ok with threshold 0.8 is trivially True (~95% of bars), making effective min_conditions = 1 of 2. volatility_breakout: min_conditions=5 requires ALL 5 conditions simultaneously (atr_spike + bb_expanding + price_breakout + vol_surge + previous_squeeze) — nearly impossible.
critical_gaps.fix: mean_reversion: change volume_threshold default to 1.2 (matching YAML) or remove vol_ok from condition count. volatility_breakout: change min_conditions default to 3 (any 3 of 5 conditions).
critical_gaps.win_rate_impact: +5-8% by filtering weak entries (mean_rev) and enabling entries (vol_breakout)

critical_gaps.title: YAML-to-code parameter key mismatches and trailing stop calibration
critical_gaps.location: trend_following.py:56 (trailing_stop_atr_mult vs trailing_stop_atr_multiplier), _runtime.py profit_target_exit (LONG-only), trend_following.py:292 (tracks highest CLOSE not HIGH)
critical_gaps.current: YAML uses trailing_stop_atr_multiplier: 1.5 but code reads trailing_stop_atr_mult with default 3.0. profit_target_exit() at _runtime.py:167 checks close >= entry*(1+pct) — only LONG. Trailing stop at trend_following.py:292 tracks highest close instead of high.
critical_gaps.fix: 1) Unify param names: either rename YAML key or add alias in code. 2) Add SHORT support to profit_target_exit: for SHORT, target = entry*(1-pct), check close <= target. 3) Track highest HIGH instead of highest CLOSE in trailing stop loop.
critical_gaps.win_rate_impact: +3-5% by fixing exit timing and parameter wiring

fix_priority.reason: Self-hedging is most damaging: conflicting strategies open opposing positions, destroying win rate at the portfolio level
Regime detection gates all strategies — without it, mean reversion fires in trends (guaranteed losses) and trend following fires in ranges (whipsaw losses)
Calibration bugs make two strategies nearly non-functional: mean_rev lets in too many weak signals, vol_breakout lets in almost none
Hardcoded strength prevents position sizing from reflecting signal quality — weak signals get same size as strong ones
YAML wiring and exit bugs — trailing stop too wide (3.0 vs 1.5), profit_target LONG-only, track close not high
Per-strategy win rates require multi-trade tracking infrastructure — larger implementation scope
Position strategy_id is prerequisite for correct GAP-4 budget checks but lower immediate impact

content.estimated_combined_win_rate_impact: +25-40% if all 7 gaps fixed (self-hedging + regime alone = +13-25%)

notes: Key architectural insight: the signal pipeline has a critical design flaw where StrategyContext.flush_signals() returns per-strategy signals that are processed independently by TradingSession._process_signal(). There is no cross-strategy coordination point. The SignalGenerator.consolidate_signals() method exists precisely for this purpose but is orphaned — never called by any code path. The fix requires inserting a grouping+consolidation step between flush_signals() and _process_signal() in engine.py:152-155. Additionally, the Position model's lack of strategy_id field means even the existing _check_strategy_budget() in RiskEngine cannot function correctly — it sums ALL positions instead of filtering by strategy_id. This is a cascading architecture gap: no strategy_id in Position -> no per-strategy exposure tracking -> no meaningful strategy budgets -> equal 1/N allocation regardless of performance.
